description: Privileged accounts not covered by MFA policy.
management_assertion: Closed by the new conditional-access policy (Admins-PhishingResistant).
retest_procedure: Retest the exception accounts under the current conditional-access policy for continued weak-factor authentication after the documented exception expiry.
reasoning: The new policy covers 19 of 26 privileged assignments. Two of the seven excluded accounts authenticated with password+SMS in June 2026 under an exception that expired 31 Mar 2026. The underlying gap, privileged and emergency access without phishing-resistant MFA, persists past the exception's own expiry, so the finding is not closed.

description: Restore tests not performed against the production database version.
retest_procedure: Confirm a restore exercise exists against the current (post-migration) production database and meets the 4-hour RTO.
reasoning: A successful backup job proves data was captured, not that it can be restored within RTO. The only restore report on file is dated 22 Aug 2024, predates the 2025 database migration, and was never repeated. Management's own assertion (backup success) does not address the control this finding was raised against, so the finding remains open.
